status: runtime; independent from the village mission catalogue

missions.title: City Courier
missions.short: Load three numbered parcels and deliver them in order 1, 2, 3.
missions.goal: Collect the three numbered parcels at the depot, then drive or walk to stops 1, 2 and 3 in ascending order. Return to CITY JOBS.
hints: Start City Courier at the CITY JOBS board in the central plaza.
Load all three parcels at the depot south of the board.
Deliver parcel 1 to the MARKET stop first, then 2, then 3.
steps: Load three numbered parcels at the depot
Deliver to stop 1, then stop 2, then stop 3
Return to the CITY JOBS board
learning: match a number to a place

missions.title: Market Stock-Up
missions.short: Collect six crates and check 2 × 3 at the market stalls.
missions.goal: Collect six stock crates, then answer how many crates two stalls with three each need. Return to CITY JOBS.
hints: Start Market Stock-Up at the CITY JOBS board.
Collect all six crates in the south-east market plaza.
At the stall, count 2 groups of 3. 2 × 3 = 6.
steps: Return to the CITY JOBS board

missions.title: Signals and Signs
missions.short: Repair cabinets 1–3 with red, amber and green, then talk to the engineer.
missions.goal: Visit the three numbered signal cabinets in order and choose red, amber, green. Then find the city engineer for sign-off.
hints: Start Signals and Signs at the CITY JOBS board.
Cabinet 1 needs RED, cabinet 2 needs AMBER, cabinet 3 needs GREEN.
After all three are fixed, talk to the engineer beside cabinet 3.
learning: match a signal colour to its order
